answer: Decoy identities: the registry plants 200 fake invite links under names like sable and opal, hidden in page markup that only scrapers read, plus a whisper feed no human opens. Any account touching a decoy is flagged, and accounts sharing its funding or timing lose 90% of epoch weight. Cost to an attacker is a one-time filter, not per identity, so the limit is plain: a careful crawler skips decoys and only lazy scripts are caught.
